species.real: Bottlenose dolphins are among the very few animals shown to recognise themselves in a mirror, a club otherwise made up of great apes, elephants and magpies.
species.name: Dolfeen

dex.text: Lives in the Shannon all year round and wouldn't dream of leaving. Follows the ferry, the tide and anyone holding a bucket.
dex.fact: The Shannon estuary has Ireland's only known resident group of bottlenose dolphins, around a hundred or more animals.

species.real: Dolphins are toothed whales: a bottlenose dolphin is more closely related to a sperm whale than a sperm whale is to a blue whale.
species.name: Estuarch

dex.text: Comes up out of a squall off Loop Head with a crack like a thunderclap, then rolls about grinning. The ferry crew wave. It does not wave back. It has flippers.
dex.fact: Each Shannon dolphin can be told apart by the nicks and notches on its dorsal fin, which researchers use like a fingerprint.
